applications.name: COMMON
applications.doc: Outdoor temperature: range check, fallback value, slow filter; shared by both circuits

blocks.label: Outdoor sensor check
blocks.why: vendor: LessThan 'if A < B, Output = 1' - reading below the plausible range = sensor fault
vendor: GreaterThan 'if A > B, Output = 1' - reading above the plausible range = sensor fault

blocks.label: Outdoor fault
blocks.why: vendor: Or 'If some input is 1, output is 1'; unused inputs untouched (excluded)

blocks.label: Fallback value
blocks.why: vendor: SwitchAn 'If Select = 0, Output = Input0. If Select = 1, Output = Input1' - substitute value on fault

blocks.label: Outdoor filter
blocks.why: vendor: SignalFilter 'first-order low-pass'; TimeConstant 'sekunteina' (seconds). Enable set 1 explicitly (Enable=0 not stated)

blocks.label: Outdoor fault status
blocks.why: vendor: OnDelay '0 to 1 is seen after a delay', '1 to 0 reflected immediately'; Enable=1 explicitly since Enable=0 passes through

blocks.label: Supply sensor check
blocks.why: vendor: LessThan 'if A < B, Output = 1' - below plausible range = open circuit / fault
vendor: GreaterThan 'if A > B, Output = 1' - above plausible range = short circuit / fault
vendor: Or 'If some input is 1, output is 1'
vendor: OnDelay 0->1 delayed by DelayTime (s), 1->0 immediate; Enable=1 explicitly

blocks.label: Summer stop
blocks.why: vendor: GreaterThan 'if A > B, Output = 1' - outdoor above stop limit
vendor: OnDelay 0->1 after DelayTime s, a dip below the limit restarts the delay (ouman-answers OnDelay-1, medium)
vendor: LessThan 'if A < B, Output = 1' - outdoor below restart limit

blocks.label: Heating curve
blocks.why: vendor: Curve_3p 'curve is defined at 3 points: -20 °C, 0 °C and +20 °C', 'cut ... with minimum and maximum limits', 'automatic adjustment of the curve convexity'; CurveOut (uncut) is used so the offset is added before the cut
vendor: SwitchAn Select=0 -> Output = Input0; pass-through puts the set value on a block output (a set value on an extendable Add input is avoided, design-rules)
vendor: SwitchAn Select=0 -> Output = Input0; minimum limit as a block output for the Max block
vendor: SwitchAn Select=0 -> Output = Input0; maximum limit as a block output for Min

blocks.label: Night setback
blocks.why: vendor: SwitchAn 'If Select = 0, Output = Input0. If Select = 1, Output = Input1' - setback amount while the time program is 0, nothing while it is 1; the time program sits on Select (an Enum block input)

blocks.label: Setpoint with limits
blocks.why: vendor: Add 'Output = A + B1 + ...'; unconnected inputs excluded
vendor: Subtract 'Output = A - B1 - ...' - setback lowers the setpoint before the limits
vendor: Max 'Output = Input which has the maximum value' - minimum cut after the offset
vendor: Min 'Output = Minimum input value' - maximum cut last, so Max wins if Min > Max

blocks.label: Summer latch
blocks.why: vendor: RS_FlipFlop 'If both S and R are 1, Output is 0' (reset dominant -> heating wins if limits overlap); both 0 'remain its state' = hysteresis

blocks.label: Set value check
blocks.why: vendor: GreaterThan - minimum supply limit above maximum is inconsistent
vendor: GreaterOrEqual 'if A >= B, Output = 1' - restart limit not below stop limit is inconsistent
vendor: Or

blocks.label: Circuit run
blocks.why: vendor: SwitchBin 'If Select = 0, Output = Input0' -> run = ENABLE AND NOT summer; RS OutputNeg 'is inverse of Output'
vendor: SwitchBin -> exercise allowed only when enabled and in summer stop

blocks.label: Pump exercise
blocks.why: vendor: OnOffPulse 'Output is 1 for OnTime (in seconds) and 0 for OffTime (in seconds)', 'If Enable = 0, Output = 0'; StartState=0 'pulsing is started by OffPulse'
vendor: Or - pump runs when the circuit runs or during an exercise pulse

blocks.label: Valve control
blocks.why: vendor: SwitchBin -> PID enable = run AND NOT supply sensor fault

vendor: Pid 5.1 'If Enable input is 0 ... output is 0%', 'Reverse ... 1 = Heating', P 'P-area' in °C (2..500), I 'I time in seconds' (5..300, 'ei saa asettaa nollaksi'); Feedback left unconnected ('If Feedback input is connected'), U32 stage pins untouched
vendor: And 'If all inputs are 1, output is 1' - fault position only while the circuit runs

blocks.label: Valve output
blocks.why: vendor: SwitchAn Select=1 -> Input1 (fixed valve position on supply sensor fault)

blocks.label: Deviation alarm

vendor: Absolute 'If Input < 0, Output = -1 * Input' (used as |x|, not as a pass-through)
vendor: GreaterThan 'if A > B, Output = 1'
vendor: And - deviation counts only while the valve is under PID control
vendor: OnDelay 0->1 after DelayTime s, 1->0 immediate (alarm clears as soon as the deviation is gone)

notes: Modbus: set values 1000+n, analog measurements 1100+n, binary status 1150+n (n = table offset); all Holding registers; registers 2..7 and 14 are system registers; the exported document shows each number +1.
Execution order: COMMON, C1, C2, ALARM. Circuits read TOUT_F from COMMON in the same cycle; ALARM reads every alarm net in the same cycle.

Setpoint = min(max(CurveOut + offset - setback, TS_MIN), TS_MAX): offset and night setback applied before the limits; the maximum limit wins if TS_MIN > TS_MAX (status bit SV_ERR). Curve_3p Min/Max carry the same set values but its cut Output is not used.
Summer stop: stop when filtered outdoor > SUM_STOP for SUM_DLY s; heating resumes at once when it is < SUM_START. Reset-dominant latch: overlapping limits give heating (status bit SV_ERR).
Pid RevPDisable left at the library default (30 °C): the vendor texts of 4.2 and 5.1 contradict each other.
AO scaling assumed 0..100 % = 0..10 V; confirm in the build.
